items.q: The interviewer lists Pauline as one of the interviewee's sisters ('There's Emma, there's Pauline... Pauline is the oldest'), but the interviewee does not speak or confirm the relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: There's Emma, there's Pauline. There's one that died about 3/4 years ago. What was the one that died?
